name: Luni (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Luni (quartered with a cross, a crescent and a vine on blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Luni, a comune in Liguria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Luni arms — quartered with a cross, a crescent and a vine on blue, crowned, within branches
